open_points.subject: runtime_settings validation ownership
open_points.text: “the refusal of a missing required setting or of a value of the wrong form”
open_points.question: Does “wrong form” include every value excluded by A8, especially a syntactically valid time-zone string that the time-zone database does not know and a numeric port outside 1–65535, or does another module reject those domain-invalid values?
options: `runtime_settings` rejects every value outside A8, treating domain-invalid values as having the wrong form
`runtime_settings` rejects only parsing/type errors; another named module rejects domain-invalid values
`runtime_settings` rejects only parsing/type errors and domain-invalid values are accepted
open_points.default_guess: Treat every value outside A8, including an unknown time zone and an out-of-range port, as the responsibility of `runtime_settings` and end the start.

witness.initial: All required environment variables are present and valid except `PORTAL_DELIVERER_TIMEZONE`, whose value is the well-formed string `Mars/Olympus`, unknown to the time-zone database.
events: `module:runtime_settings` decides whether the well-formed but unknown value is a value “of the wrong form”.
outcomes: Following A8, `load_runtime_settings` rejects the unknown time zone and the process ends without listening.
Reading “wrong form” as only a syntax or type failure, `load_runtime_settings` accepts the string and start-up continues.
witness.observer: The deployment operator sees whether the service begins listening.
